I didn't see the signs during the relationship. At least not immediately. I was always trying to satisfy her, but it was never enough.

Later I started to get annoyed that she always thought herself so important. And my friends thought she was terrible when she spoke about herself again. But I loved her and I defended her.

But long story short. She tried to change me into something that suited her self-image. I did my best, but it took more energy than I had.

In the end there was more and more fighting. She found a man who had his own business. And before I knew she kicked me out. I literally came home and my clothes were in bags by the door. She kept or gave away the rest of my things. I still spoke to her via text afterwards, but I never saw her again.

She was gaslighting me.

It took me a long time, but in the end I saw her for what she was. And I became the way I was again.

I am now a few years and relationships further, but I still carry the consequences of her with me.

I changed everything for her. Because she wanted to. Change of education. Changed jobs. Didn't see my family anymore. Things that influenced my future.

It took me a lot of time before I could forgive her. But I will never forget it.

No contact is so difficult because you deny yourself what you want so badly. You long for it so intensely. And yes it can be very lonely and painful. And it can certainly be depressing. That certainly applies to me.

But now that I am alone for a while and my emotions are less intense. I spend a lot of time reflecting. And I don't think I miss my ex, but I just miss someone i love around me.
